zh: 站在長凳或穩固的椅子前方約一大步的位置，把後腳的腳背放在椅面上。
挺胸、身體微微前傾，重心大部分放在前腳，前腳整個腳掌踩穩地面。
吸氣，彎曲前腳膝蓋讓身體直直往下，蹲到前腳大腿大約與地面平行，或自己舒服的深度。
吐氣，前腳踩地用力站起來；一側做完再換另一隻腳。
en: Stand about one big step in front of a bench or sturdy chair and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Keep your chest up with a slight forward lean, most of your weight on the front leg, and the whole front foot flat on the floor.
Breathe in and bend the front knee to lower straight down until the front thigh is about level with the floor, or as low as feels comfortable.
Breathe out and push through the front foot to stand back up; finish one side, then switch legs.

zh: 前腳膝蓋往內倒：讓膝蓋一直朝向腳尖的方向。
用後腳出力撐起來：後腳只是用來維持平衡，把重心留在前腳。
站得離椅子太近，前腳腳跟離地：前腳再往前站一點，讓腳跟全程踩住地面。
en: Front knee falling inward: keep the knee pointing the same way as your toes.
Pushing up with the back leg: the back foot is only there for balance, so keep your weight on the front leg.
Standing too close to the bench so the front heel lifts: step a little further forward so the heel stays down the whole time.

zh: 雙腳與髖同寬站穩（或坐直），單手把啞鈴拿在肩膀高度，手腕在手肘的正上方。
收緊腹部和臀部，肋骨不要往前頂，身體保持直立。
吐氣，把啞鈴直直往上推，推到手臂伸直、上臂靠近耳朵旁邊。
吸氣，慢慢把啞鈴放回肩膀高度；一側做完再換手。
en: Stand with feet hip-width apart (or sit tall) and hold one dumbbell at shoulder height, with your wrist directly above your elbow.
Tighten your stomach and buttocks, keep your ribs from flaring forward, and keep your body upright.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight and your upper arm is next to your ear.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbell slowly back to shoulder height; finish one side, then switch arms.

zh: 身體往旁邊歪或腰往後拱：先收緊腹部和臀部，必要時換輕一點的重量。
手腕往後折：握緊啞鈴，讓手腕打直並保持在手肘正上方。
放下時讓啞鈴直接掉下來：下放要比上推更慢、有控制。
en: Leaning to the side or arching the lower back: tighten your stomach and buttocks first, and use a lighter weight if needed.
Wrist bending backward: grip firmly and keep the wrist straight and stacked above the elbow.
Letting the dumbbell drop on the way down: lower it more slowly than you pressed it, under control.

zh: 單腳站立，站立腳的膝蓋微彎；可以用對側的手拿啞鈴，或先不拿重量練習。
臀部往後推，上半身向前傾，同時另一隻腳往後伸直；背部保持平直，骨盆兩側維持一樣高、朝向地面。
吸氣慢慢往下，直到站立腳的大腿後側有伸展感，或上半身接近與地面平行。
吐氣，夾緊站立腳那一側的臀部，把髖部往前帶，回到站直的姿勢；一側做完再換腳。
en: Stand on one leg with that knee slightly bent; hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand, or practise with no weight first.
Push your hips back and lean your trunk forward while the other leg reaches straight behind you; keep your back flat and both sides of the pelvis level, facing the floor.
Breathe in as you lower slowly, until you feel a stretch at the back of the standing thigh or your trunk is nearly level with the floor.
Breathe out, squeeze the buttock of the standing leg and bring your hips forward to stand tall again; finish one side, then switch legs.

zh: 彎腰駝背：胸口保持打開，只下降到背部還能維持平直的深度。
骨盆往外翻開、身體旋轉：後腳腳尖朝向地面，讓兩側骨盆都對著地板。
站不穩一直晃：先用手輕扶牆壁或椅背，或每一下之間讓後腳腳尖點地。
en: Rounding the back: keep your chest open and only go as low as your back can stay flat.
Pelvis opening out and the body twisting: point the toes of the back foot at the floor so both sides of the pelvis face down.
Wobbling and losing balance: lightly hold a wall or chair back, or tap the back toes on the floor between repetitions.

zh: 仰躺在臥推椅上，雙腳踩穩地面，頭、上背和臀部都貼著椅面；單手握啞鈴，手臂伸直舉在胸口上方，另一隻手放在腹部或往旁邊張開。
肩胛骨輕輕往後、往下收，收緊腹部，不讓身體往拿啞鈴的那一側滾。
吸氣，慢慢把啞鈴放到胸口外側，手肘與身體大約夾 45 度。
吐氣，把啞鈴往上推回肩膀正上方、手臂伸直；一側做完再換手。
en: Lie on a bench with both feet flat on the floor and your head, upper back and buttocks on the bench; hold one dumbbell with a straight arm above your chest and rest the other hand on your stomach or out to the side.
Gently pull your shoulder blades back and down and tighten your stomach so your body does not roll toward the dumbbell side.
Breathe in and slowly lower the dumbbell to the outside of your chest, with the elbow about 45 degrees from your body.
Breathe out and press the dumbbell back up above the shoulder until the arm is straight; finish one side, then switch arms.

zh: 身體往拿啞鈴的那一側翻轉：雙腳用力踩地、收緊腹部，必要時換輕一點的重量。
手肘張太開、抬到與肩膀同高：把手肘收到與身體大約 45 度的位置。
推的時候臀部離開椅面：臀部全程貼住椅面，不要靠拱腰借力。
en: Body rolling toward the dumbbell side: press both feet into the floor, tighten your stomach, and use a lighter weight if needed.
Elbow flaring out level with the shoulder: tuck the elbow to about 45 degrees from your body.
Buttocks lifting off the bench as you press: keep them on the bench the whole time instead of arching to help.

zh: 一手和同側的膝蓋撐在長凳上，另一隻腳踩在地上；背部打平，大約與地面平行。
另一手握啞鈴，手臂自然垂直在肩膀正下方。
吐氣，手肘貼近身體，往後上方朝髖部的方向拉，把啞鈴拉到腰側。
吸氣，慢慢放下到手臂伸直；一側做完再換邊。
en: Put one hand and the same-side knee on a bench with the other foot on the floor; keep your back flat and roughly level with the floor.
Hold the dumbbell in the free hand and let the arm hang straight down under the shoulder.
Breathe out and pull your elbow up and back toward your hip, keeping it close to your body, until the dumbbell reaches the side of your waist.
Breathe in and lower slowly until the arm is straight; finish one side, then switch.

zh: 身體跟著轉開、用甩的把啞鈴拉起來：胸口保持朝向地面，換輕一點的重量慢慢拉。
駝背或圓肩：從頭到尾椎拉長成一直線，胸口微微打開。
聳肩、只用手臂出力：想著「把手肘拉向髖部」，肩膀遠離耳朵。
en: Twisting the body open and swinging the dumbbell up: keep your chest facing the floor and pull slowly with a lighter weight.
Rounding the back or shoulders: stay long in a straight line from head to tailbone with the chest slightly open.
Shrugging and pulling only with the arm: think about pulling the elbow toward the hip and keep the shoulder away from the ear.

zh: 雙腳與肩同寬站好，腳尖微微朝外，挺胸、眼睛看前方。
吸氣並收緊腹部，髖部和膝蓋一起彎曲，像要往後坐到椅子上一樣往下蹲。
蹲到大腿大約與地面平行，或在腳跟不離地、背部能保持平直的範圍內蹲到舒服的深度；膝蓋朝向腳尖的方向。
吐氣，整個腳掌用力踩地，站回直立姿勢。
en: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, chest up and eyes looking ahead.
Breathe in and tighten your stomach, then bend your hips and knees together and lower as if sitting back onto a chair.
Go down until your thighs are about level with the floor, or as low as is comfortable while your heels stay down and your back stays flat; keep the knees pointing the same way as the toes.
Breathe out, push the floor away with your whole foot and stand back up tall.

zh: 膝蓋往內夾：膝蓋輕輕往外推，對齊腳尖的方向。
腳跟離地：重心放在整個腳掌，先蹲淺一點或把站距稍微加寬。
彎腰駝背、上半身往前倒：挺胸並收緊腹部，只蹲到背部還能保持平直的深度。
en: Knees caving inward: gently push the knees out so they line up with the toes.
Heels lifting off the floor: keep your weight over the whole foot, and squat less deep or stand slightly wider at first.
Rounding the back and falling forward: lift your chest, tighten your stomach, and only go as low as your back can stay flat.

zh: 雙腳與髖同寬站好，槓鈴在腳掌中段的正上方、靠近小腿。
臀部往後推、膝蓋彎曲，雙手握在小腿外側的槓上；背部打平、挺胸、手臂伸直。
吸氣並收緊腹部，雙腳用力推地站起來，槓鈴全程貼近雙腿。
站到髖部和膝蓋都伸直、身體直立就好，不要往後仰，然後吐氣。
先把臀部往後推，再彎膝蓋，讓槓鈴沿著雙腿有控制地放回地面。
en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the bar over the middle of your feet, close to your shins.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs; keep your back flat, chest lifted and arms straight.
Breathe in and tighten your stomach, then push the floor away with your legs and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs the whole way.
Finish standing tall with hips and knees straight, without leaning back, then breathe out.
Push your hips back first, then bend your knees, and lower the bar down along your legs under control.

zh: 下背拱起來變圓：拉之前先挺胸、收緊腹部，做不到就先減輕重量。
槓鈴離身體太遠：讓槓鈴全程沿著小腿和大腿往上、往下。
猛力一扯或用手臂硬拉：手臂保持伸直，先把槓拉緊，再用雙腳推地發力。
en: Lower back rounding: lift your chest and tighten your stomach before you pull, and reduce the weight if you cannot hold it.
Bar drifting away from the body: keep the bar travelling up and down along your shins and thighs.
Jerking the bar or pulling with the arms: keep the arms straight, take the slack out of the bar first, then push through your legs.

zh: 仰躺、膝蓋彎曲，雙腳與髖同寬踩在地上，腳跟離臀部一個舒服的距離（做臀推時，改成上背靠在長凳邊緣）。
輕輕收緊腹部，肋骨往下收，不要拱腰。
吐氣，腳跟踩地、夾緊臀部，把髖部往上抬，直到肩膀、髖部和膝蓋成一直線。
在最高點停一下，再吸氣慢慢放下。
en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart, heels a comfortable distance from your buttocks (for a hip thrust, rest your upper back on the edge of a bench instead).
Lightly tighten your stomach and keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.
Breathe out, press through your heels and squeeze your buttocks to lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.
Pause briefly at the top, then breathe in and lower slowly.

zh: 在最高點把腰拱起來：抬到身體成一直線就停，肋骨往下收，用臀部出力而不是腰。
主要是大腿後側在痠：把腳跟往臀部收近一點，並用腳跟踩地。
膝蓋往內夾或往外倒：讓膝蓋對齊髖部和腳掌。
en: Arching the lower back at the top: stop when your body is in a straight line, keep the ribs down, and lift with your buttocks rather than your back.
Feeling it mostly in the back of the thighs: bring your heels a little closer to your buttocks and push through the heels.
Knees falling in or out: keep the knees lined up with your hips and feet.

zh: 側躺抬腿：側躺讓身體成一直線，下方的膝蓋彎曲幫助穩定，上方的腿伸直，骨盆上下對齊。
腳尖朝前（不要朝上），吐氣，把上方的腿往上並稍微往後抬，抬到骨盆不會跟著翻動的高度就好。
吸氣，慢慢放下；一側做完再換邊。
彈力帶側走：把彈力帶套在膝蓋上方或腳踝，髖部和膝蓋微彎，小步往旁邊走，全程讓彈力帶保持繃緊、雙腳不要併攏；左右兩個方向都要走。
en: Side-lying leg raise: lie on your side with your body in a straight line, bottom knee bent for stability, top leg straight and hips stacked one above the other.
With your toes pointing forward (not up), breathe out and lift the top leg up and slightly back, only as high as you can without your pelvis rolling.
Breathe in and lower slowly; finish one side, then switch.

Banded side step: put a band around your legs above the knees or at the ankles, bend your hips and knees slightly, and take small steps sideways, keeping the band tight and your feet apart the whole time; step in both directions.

zh: 骨盆往後倒、腳尖朝上翻：骨盆保持上下對齊、腳尖朝前，可以背靠牆壁練習。
腿抬得太高，變成用腰側出力：降低抬腿高度，身體和腰保持不動。
側走時身體左右搖晃或膝蓋內夾：維持微蹲、上半身穩定，膝蓋對齊腳尖。
en: Pelvis rolling backward and toes turning up: keep your hips stacked and toes pointing forward; practising with your back against a wall can help.
Lifting the leg so high that the waist does the work: lift lower and keep your trunk and waist still.
Trunk swaying or knees caving in during side steps: stay slightly bent, keep your upper body steady and your knees in line with your toes.

zh: 側躺，髖部彎曲約 45 度、膝蓋彎曲約 90 度，雙腳併攏，頭枕在手臂或枕頭上，骨盆上下對齊。

停一下，吸氣慢慢放回；一側做完再換邊。
en: Lie on your side with hips bent about 45 degrees and knees bent about 90 degrees, feet together, head resting on your arm or a pillow, hips stacked one above the other.
Lightly tighten your stomach and keep your heels touching.
Breathe out and lift the top knee like a clamshell opening, as far as you can without your pelvis rolling backward.
Pause, then breathe in and lower slowly; finish one side, then switch.

zh: 骨盆跟著往後倒：一手放在上方的骨盆上檢查，或背靠牆壁做，並把動作幅度縮小。
雙腳分開：腳跟全程貼在一起，只有膝蓋打開。
做得太快、用甩的：放慢速度，打開和放下都要有控制。
en: Pelvis rolling backward with the knee: rest a hand on your top hip to check, or do it with your back against a wall, and use a smaller movement.
Feet coming apart: keep the heels together the whole time so only the knee opens.
Moving too fast and swinging the leg: slow down and control both the opening and the lowering.

zh: 夾球：仰躺、膝蓋彎曲、雙腳踩地，在兩個膝蓋之間夾一顆球或枕頭。
吐氣，雙膝往內輕輕夾緊球，停留一下再慢慢放鬆；過程中保持自然呼吸，不要憋氣。
哥本哈根側棒式：側躺，下方的前臂撐地、手肘在肩膀正下方，把上方那隻腳的膝蓋內側（較簡單）或腳踝內側（較困難）放在長凳上。
上方的腿往下壓住長凳，把髖部抬起來，讓身體從頭到腳成一直線，下方的腿抬起靠近長凳；穩定呼吸撐住，再慢慢放下並換邊。
en: Adductor squeeze: lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, and place a ball or pillow between your knees.
Breathe out and gently squeeze the ball with both knees, hold briefly, then relax slowly; keep breathing normally and do not hold your breath.
Copenhagen plank: lie on your side with your bottom forearm on the floor and the elbow under your shoulder, and rest the inside of your top knee (easier) or top ankle (harder) on a bench.

Press the top leg down into the bench and lift your hips until your body is in a straight line from head to feet, bringing the bottom leg up toward the bench; hold with steady breathing, then lower slowly and switch sides.

zh: 髖部往下掉或身體轉向地面：保持身體成一直線，撐不住就改用膝蓋放在長凳上的版本。
一開始就用盡全力夾、同時憋氣：力量慢慢加上去，並保持穩定呼吸。
肩膀塌陷、聳向耳朵：手肘放在肩膀正下方，前臂用力推地把身體撐高。
en: Hips sagging or the body turning toward the floor: keep a straight line, and switch to the version with the knee on the bench if you cannot hold it.
Squeezing as hard as possible straight away while holding your breath: build the pressure up gradually and keep breathing steadily.
Shoulder sinking and shrugging toward the ear: keep the elbow under the shoulder and push the floor away with your forearm.

zh: 坐上腿伸展機，背部靠穩椅背；調整座椅讓膝蓋對齊機器的轉軸，滾筒墊放在小腿前側、腳踝上方一點的位置。

吐氣，平順地把膝蓋伸直，直到雙腿接近打直，在最高點停一下。
吸氣，慢慢放回起始位置，不要讓配重片撞出聲音。
en: Sit on the leg extension machine with your back against the backrest; adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot, and set the roller pad on the front of your lower shins just above the ankles.
Hold the side handles and keep your hips and back against the seat the whole time.
Breathe out and smoothly straighten your knees until your legs are nearly straight, then pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in and lower slowly to the start, without letting the weight stack bang down.

zh: 用甩的把重量踢上去、臀部離開座椅：減輕重量，握緊把手，平順地出力。
膝蓋沒有對齊機器轉軸，或滾筒墊位置太高：重新調整椅背和滾筒墊再開始。
放下時直接讓重量掉下來：下放要比抬起更慢、有控制。
en: Kicking the weight up with a swing so the hips lift off the seat: reduce the weight, hold the handles and lift smoothly.
Knees not lined up with the machine's pivot, or the pad sitting too high on the shins: re-adjust the backrest and pad before you start.
Letting the weight drop on the way down: lower it more slowly than you lifted it, under control.

zh: 機器腿彎舉：調整機器，讓膝蓋對齊機器的轉軸，滾筒墊靠在腳跟上方的小腿後側，髖部貼緊椅墊。

吸氣，用比彎起來更慢的速度把腿放回，膝蓋接近伸直但不要鎖死。
北歐腿彎舉：跪在軟墊上，請夥伴或穩固的物體固定腳踝，身體從膝蓋到頭保持一直線。
身體慢慢往前倒，用大腿後側盡量煞車；撐不住時用雙手撐地，再推回起始位置。
en: Machine curl: adjust the machine so your knees line up with its pivot, the roller pad rests on the back of your lower legs just above the heels, and your hips stay against the pad.
Breathe out and bend your knees slowly, using the back of your thighs to pull the roller toward your buttocks; pause briefly at the tightest point.
Breathe in and let the legs return more slowly than you curled them, stopping just short of locking the knees.
Nordic curl: kneel on a soft pad with your ankles held by a partner or a sturdy object, and keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lean forward slowly, braking with the back of your thighs for as long as you can; when you can no longer hold, catch yourself with your hands and push back to the start.

zh: 臀部翹起或腰部拱起借力：把髖部壓回椅墊、收緊腹部，必要時減輕重量。
放下時讓重量直接掉回去：放回的過程要全程控制，速度比彎起時更慢。
做北歐腿彎舉時屁股往後坐、身體折起來：收緊臀部，保持膝蓋到肩膀一直線，寧可縮小下降幅度。
en: Lifting the hips or arching the lower back to help: press your hips back into the pad, tighten your abdomen, and reduce the weight if needed.
Letting the weight drop on the way back: control the whole return, moving slower than you did on the curl.
Bending at the hips during the Nordic curl: squeeze your glutes and keep knees to shoulders in one line, even if that means lowering a shorter distance.

zh: 雙腳與髖同寬站好，腳尖朝前，手輕扶牆壁或椅背幫助平衡。
吐氣，前腳掌往下踩，把腳跟慢慢抬到最高，重心落在大拇趾與第二趾的根部。
在最高點停一下，膝蓋保持伸直但不要鎖死，身體不要往前傾。
吸氣，慢慢把腳跟放回地面，再做下一下。
en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward, resting a hand lightly on a wall or chair back for balance.
Breathe out, press through the balls of your feet and slowly lift your heels as high as you can, keeping the weight over the base of the big toe and second toe.
Pause at the top with your knees straight but not locked and your body upright, not leaning forward.
Breathe in and lower your heels slowly back to the floor before the next repetition.

zh: 腳踝往外倒、重心跑到小趾側：把重量壓回大拇趾根部，讓腳跟直上直下。
動作太快、用彈的：放慢速度，最高點停一下，再慢慢放下。
只抬一半高度：每一下都抬到自己能到的最高點，再完整放下。
en: Ankles rolling outward so the weight shifts to the little-toe side: press back through the base of the big toe so the heels travel straight up and down.
Bouncing through the movement: slow down, pause at the top, and lower with control.
Lifting only halfway: rise to the highest point you can reach each time, then lower all the way.

zh: 背部和臀部靠牆站好，雙腳往前踏出約一個腳掌的距離，膝蓋伸直。
腳跟留在地上，吐氣，把腳尖和前腳掌往小腿方向勾起到最高。

吸氣，慢慢把前腳掌放回地面；腳站得離牆越遠，動作越吃力。
en: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet about one foot-length in front of you and knees straight.
Keeping your heels on the floor, breathe out and pull your toes and the front of your feet up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause at the top and feel the front of your shins working.
Breathe in and lower the front of your feet slowly to the floor; the farther your feet are from the wall, the harder it is.

zh: 彎膝蓋或臀部離開牆面借力：膝蓋保持伸直、臀部貼牆，太吃力就把腳站近一點。
只翹腳趾、腳掌沒有離地：想著把整個前腳掌抬離地面，而不只是腳趾。
放下時腳掌直接拍回地面：放下的速度要和抬起時一樣慢。
en: Bending the knees or letting the hips leave the wall to help: keep the knees straight and hips on the wall, and step your feet closer if it is too hard.
Lifting only the toes while the foot stays down: think about raising the whole front of the foot off the floor, not just the toes.
Letting the feet slap back down: lower as slowly as you lifted.

zh: 雙手與肩同寬握住單槓，手臂伸直懸吊，肩膀往下沉、不要聳肩，雙腿自然併攏。
收緊腹部，吐氣，把膝蓋慢慢往胸口方向抬起，到大腿至少與地面平行，骨盆順勢往上捲。
在最高點停一下，身體盡量不要前後晃動。
吸氣，慢慢把腿放回起始位置，等身體穩定後再做下一下。
進階做法：雙腿伸直抬起（懸吊抬腿）；無法懸吊時，可改成仰躺在地上抬膝。
en: Hang from a bar with hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight, shoulders pulled down away from your ears, and legs together.
Tighten your abdomen, breathe out and slowly bring your knees up toward your chest until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, letting your pelvis curl upward.
Pause at the top and keep your body from swinging back and forth.
Breathe in, lower your legs slowly to the start, and wait until you are steady before the next repetition.
To progress, raise straight legs (hanging leg raise); if hanging is not possible, do knee raises lying on your back instead.

zh: 靠身體擺盪把腿甩上去：放慢速度，每一下都從靜止開始，腿放下後先停穩。
聳肩、整個人掛在肩關節上：肩膀往下沉、肩胛骨微微用力，讓脖子保持放鬆拉長。
只抬腿、骨盆沒有捲起，腰部拱起：抬到上方時把骨盆往上捲、肚臍往內收，讓腹部出力。
en: Swinging the body to throw the legs up: slow down, start each repetition from a still hang, and settle after lowering.
Shrugging and hanging passively from the shoulder joints: draw the shoulders down and keep the shoulder blades gently engaged so the neck stays long.
Lifting only the legs while the lower back arches: curl the pelvis up and draw the navel in at the top so the abdominals do the work.

zh: 坐著把腿伸直，彈力帶套在要訓練那隻腳的前腳掌，另一端固定在身體內側（綁在桌腳，或繞過另一隻腳用手拉住）。
小腿和膝蓋保持不動，腳踝維持在自然的角度。
吐氣，把腳掌外緣慢慢往外、往上轉，讓腳底朝向外側，對抗彈力帶的拉力。
在最外側停一下，吸氣，慢慢回到起始位置，不要讓彈力帶把腳彈回去。
en: Sit with your leg out straight and loop the band around the front of the working foot, with the other end fixed toward the inside (tied to a table leg, or wrapped around the other foot and held in your hand).
Keep your lower leg and knee still, with the ankle in a comfortable neutral position.
Breathe out and slowly turn the outer edge of your foot outward and upward so the sole faces away from the midline, working against the band.
Pause at the end, then breathe in and return slowly to the start without letting the band snap your foot back.

zh: 整條腿或膝蓋跟著往外轉：用手扶住小腿，只讓腳踝以下的部位活動。
變成把腳尖往下踩或往上勾：動作方向是腳掌往外轉，腳踝的上下角度保持不變。
回程太快被彈力帶拉回去：回來的速度要比出去時更慢，全程保持張力。
en: The whole leg or knee turning outward: steady your lower leg with a hand and move only from the ankle down.
Pointing or pulling the foot up instead: the movement is the foot turning outward while the up-and-down ankle angle stays the same.
Letting the band pull the foot back quickly: return more slowly than you moved out, keeping tension the whole way.

zh: 赤腳坐在椅子上，腳掌平放地面，膝蓋在腳踝正上方，腳趾放鬆伸直。
腳跟和腳趾都留在地上，把大拇趾根部往腳跟方向輕輕拉近，讓足弓微微拱起、腳掌變短一點。
維持這個姿勢幾秒，保持正常呼吸，腳趾不要捲曲抓地。
慢慢放鬆讓足弓回到原位；熟練後可以改成站著做，再進階到單腳站。
en: Sit barefoot on a chair with your foot flat on the floor, knee directly over the ankle, and toes relaxed and straight.
Keeping the heel and toes on the floor, gently draw the base of your big toe toward your heel so the arch lifts slightly and the foot becomes a little shorter.
Hold for a few seconds while breathing normally, without curling or gripping with your toes.
Relax slowly and let the arch return; once this is easy, do it standing and then on one leg.

zh: 腳趾捲起來抓地：腳趾保持伸直平貼地面，只讓足弓拱起；可以先用手指輕壓腳趾提醒自己。
腳掌往外翻、大拇趾根部離地：大拇趾根部、小趾根部和腳跟三個點都要留在地上。
太用力、小腿和腳整個繃緊：用輕輕的力量就好，重點是感覺足弓內側的小肌肉在收縮。
en: Curling the toes to grip the floor: keep the toes long and flat and let only the arch rise; resting a finger lightly on the toes can remind you.
Rolling the foot outward so the base of the big toe lifts: keep the base of the big toe, the base of the little toe, and the heel all on the floor.
Tensing the whole foot and calf: use gentle effort and focus on feeling the small muscles of the inner arch contract.

zh: 雙手撐地，比肩膀略寬，手掌在肩膀正下方附近，雙腳往後伸直，腳尖踩地。
收緊腹部和臀部，讓頭、背、臀、腳跟成一直線，眼睛看向手前方的地面。
吸氣，彎曲手肘讓身體整體往下，手肘與身體約呈 45 度，胸口接近地面。
吐氣，手掌用力推地，把身體推回起始位置，手肘伸直但不要鎖死。
太吃力時，可改成膝蓋著地或雙手撐在椅子、桌緣上做。
en: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders and roughly under them, with legs straight behind you and toes on the floor.
Tighten your abdomen and glutes so your head, back, hips and heels form one straight line, and look at the floor just ahead of your hands.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your whole body together, elbows about 45 degrees from your sides, until your chest is close to the floor.
Breathe out and push the floor away to return to the start, straightening the elbows without locking them.
If this is too hard, do it with your knees on the floor or with your hands on a chair or table edge.

zh: 腰部下塌或臀部翹高：收緊腹部和臀部，讓身體像一塊木板一樣一起上下。
手肘往兩側張開成 90 度：手肘往後收到與身體約 45 度，減少肩膀前側的壓力。
只下去一點點、頭往前伸：下巴微收，以胸口而不是額頭靠近地面，做不到就先降低難度。
en: Sagging at the waist or lifting the hips high: tighten the abdomen and glutes so the body moves up and down like one plank.
Flaring the elbows out to 90 degrees: tuck them back to about 45 degrees from the body to ease the load on the front of the shoulders.
Lowering only a little while poking the head forward: tuck the chin slightly and lead with the chest, not the forehead, and use an easier version if you cannot reach depth.

zh: 雙手正握單槓（或下拉機的橫桿），握距比肩膀略寬，手臂伸直，腹部收緊。
先把肩膀往下沉、肩胛骨往下往後帶，胸口微微挺起。
吐氣，想著把手肘往下拉向身體兩側，直到下巴超過單槓（滑輪下拉則是把橫桿拉到上胸前）。
在最高點停一下，吸氣，慢慢回到手臂伸直的位置，全程保持控制。
還拉不上去時，可以用彈力帶輔助、只練慢慢下放，或先用滑輪下拉機練習。
en: Grip the bar (or the pulldown bar) overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders, with arms straight and abdomen tight.
First draw your shoulders down and your shoulder blades down and back, lifting your chest slightly.
Breathe out and think of driving your elbows down toward your sides until your chin clears the bar (for a pulldown, bring the bar to your upper chest).
Pause at the top, then breathe in and return slowly to straight arms, staying in control the whole way.
If you cannot pull yourself up yet, use a band for assistance, practise only the slow lowering, or start on the lat pulldown machine.

zh: 聳肩、用脖子和手臂硬拉：每一下開始前先把肩膀往下沉，再用背部把手肘往下帶。
踢腿或擺盪身體借力（滑輪下拉時身體大幅後仰）：收緊腹部和臀部保持身體穩定，必要時降低難度或重量。
沒有完整放下、只做半程：每一下都回到手臂接近伸直的位置，但肩膀仍保持穩定不鬆掉。
en: Shrugging and pulling with the neck and arms: set the shoulders down before each repetition, then use your back to drive the elbows down.
Kicking or swinging for momentum (or leaning far back on a pulldown): tighten the abdomen and glutes to stay steady, and use an easier version or lighter weight if needed.
Half repetitions that never lower fully: return to nearly straight arms each time while keeping the shoulders stable rather than slack.

zh: 雙腳與髖同寬站好，雙手各握一個啞鈴垂在身體兩側，掌心朝向身體，手肘微彎。
收緊腹部，肩膀放鬆下沉，身體站直不晃動。
吐氣，以手肘帶動，把手臂往兩側稍微偏前的方向抬起，到手臂約與肩同高。
在最高點停一下，吸氣，慢慢把啞鈴放回身體兩側。
en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your body and elbows slightly bent.
Tighten your abdomen, let your shoulders settle down, and stand tall without swaying.
Breathe out and, leading with your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides and slightly forward until they are about shoulder height.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly back to your sides.

zh: 聳肩、用斜方肌把手抬起來：先把肩膀往下沉，並改用較輕的重量，想著把手往兩側遠處伸出去。
身體後仰或用甩的把重量帶上去：身體保持不動，抬起和放下都放慢速度。
手抬得比肩膀高或手腕高過手肘：抬到與肩同高就停，讓手肘和手腕保持在差不多的高度。
en: Shrugging so the upper traps lift the arms: set the shoulders down first, use a lighter weight, and think of reaching out wide to the sides.
Leaning back or swinging the weights up: keep the torso still and slow down both the lift and the lowering.
Raising above shoulder height or letting the wrists rise above the elbows: stop at shoulder level and keep elbows and wrists at about the same height.

zh: 反向飛鳥：雙手各握一個輕啞鈴，膝蓋微彎，從髖部往前彎到上半身接近與地面平行，背部打直，手臂自然垂下、手肘微彎。
吐氣，把手臂往兩側張開，像展開翅膀一樣抬到約與肩同高，同時把肩胛骨往中間夾。
在最高點停一下，吸氣，慢慢把手臂放回起始位置。
面拉：把繩索或彈力帶固定在約臉部高度，雙手握住後退到手臂伸直；吐氣，手肘抬高往兩側拉開，把雙手拉向臉的兩旁。
拉到底時讓雙手在耳朵旁、手肘與肩膀同高，停一下，再吸氣慢慢伸直手臂回去。
en: Reverse fly: hold a light dumbbell in each hand, soften your knees and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, back straight, arms hanging with elbows slightly bent.
Breathe out and open your arms out to the sides like spreading wings until they are about shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top, then breathe in and lower your arms slowly to the start.
Face pull: fix a rope or band at about face height, hold it and step back until your arms are straight; breathe out and pull your hands toward the sides of your face with elbows high and wide.
Finish with your hands beside your ears and elbows level with your shoulders, pause, then breathe in and straighten your arms slowly.

zh: 重量太重、用甩的或抬起上半身借力：換較輕的重量，身體固定不動，只讓手臂和肩胛骨活動。
聳肩、脖子用力：肩膀遠離耳朵，想著用上背和肩膀後側出力，而不是脖子。
面拉時手肘掉到肩膀以下、變成划船：手肘保持與肩同高或略高，雙手拉向臉旁而不是胸口。
en: Going too heavy and swinging or lifting the torso: use a lighter weight, keep the body still, and let only the arms and shoulder blades move.
Shrugging and tensing the neck: keep the shoulders away from the ears and work from the upper back and the back of the shoulders.
Elbows dropping below the shoulders on a face pull so it becomes a row: keep the elbows at or just above shoulder height and pull toward your face, not your chest.

zh: 把彈力帶固定在約手肘高度，側身站立，用離固定點較遠的那隻手握住彈力帶。
手肘彎 90 度貼在身體側邊（可在手肘和身體之間夾一條捲起的毛巾），前臂橫在肚子前方，手腕打直。
肩膀放鬆下沉，吐氣，手肘位置不動，把前臂像開門一樣慢慢往外轉開。
轉到自己舒服的最大範圍停一下，吸氣，慢慢回到起始位置。
en: Fix the band at about elbow height, stand side-on to it, and hold the band with the hand farther from the anchor.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees and keep it against your side (a rolled towel between elbow and body helps), forearm across your belly and wrist straight.
Let your shoulder settle down, breathe out and, keeping the elbow in place, slowly rotate your forearm outward like opening a door.
Pause at the end of your comfortable range, then breathe in and return slowly to the start.

zh: 手肘離開身體往外張：在手肘和身體之間夾一條毛巾，全程不要讓它掉下來。
轉動身體或彎手腕來代替肩膀轉動：身體面向正前方不動、手腕打直，只讓前臂繞著上臂轉。
彈力帶太緊導致聳肩：站近一點或換較輕的彈力帶，肩膀保持放鬆下沉。
en: The elbow drifting away from the body: hold a towel between the elbow and your side and do not let it fall.
Twisting the torso or bending the wrist instead of rotating the shoulder: keep facing forward with a straight wrist so only the forearm turns around the upper arm.
Too much band tension causing a shrug: step closer or use a lighter band and keep the shoulder relaxed and down.

zh: 把彈力帶固定在約手肘高度，側身站立，用靠近固定點的那隻手握住彈力帶。
手肘彎 90 度貼在身體側邊（可夾一條捲起的毛巾），前臂朝向外側，手腕打直，彈力帶略有張力。
肩膀放鬆下沉，吐氣，手肘位置不動，把前臂像關門一樣慢慢往內轉向肚子。
手靠近肚子時停一下，吸氣，慢慢讓前臂轉回起始位置。
en: Fix the band at about elbow height, stand side-on to it, and hold the band with the hand nearer the anchor.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees and keep it against your side (a rolled towel can help), forearm pointing outward, wrist straight, with light tension on the band.
Let your shoulder settle down, breathe out and, keeping the elbow in place, slowly rotate your forearm inward toward your belly like closing a door.
Pause when your hand is near your belly, then breathe in and let the forearm rotate slowly back to the start.

zh: 手肘離開身體或往前跑：把手肘固定在身體側邊，夾一條毛巾幫助自己維持位置。
肩膀往前捲、身體跟著轉：胸口保持打開，身體面向正前方，只讓前臂轉動。
回程被彈力帶快速拉回去：回到起始位置的速度要放慢，全程控制。
en: The elbow leaving your side or moving forward: keep it pinned to your side, holding a towel there to help you stay in position.
The shoulder rolling forward and the torso turning with it: keep the chest open and face straight ahead so only the forearm rotates.
Letting the band pull the arm back quickly: slow the return and stay in control the whole way.

zh: 站直，雙腳與髖同寬，雙手自然垂在身體兩側，各握一個啞鈴（初學可先不拿重量），掌心朝向身體。
手臂保持伸直放鬆，吐氣，把兩邊肩膀筆直往耳朵方向抬高。
在最高點停一下，感覺脖子兩側到肩膀上方的肌肉收緊。
吸氣，慢慢把肩膀放回原位，完全放鬆後再做下一下；全程頭不動、眼睛看前方。
en: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms hanging at your sides, a dumbbell in each hand (start with no weight if you are new), palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and relaxed, breathe out, and lift both shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a moment at the top and feel the muscles between your neck and shoulders tighten.
Breathe in and lower your shoulders slowly until they are fully relaxed before the next one; keep your head still and look straight ahead the whole time.

zh: 肩膀前後繞圈：這個動作只需要直上直下，請想像肩膀沿著一條垂直線上下移動。
彎手肘用手臂把重量拉起來：把手臂當成兩條繩子掛著重量，只讓肩膀出力。
下巴往前伸、脖子用力：下巴微收，耳朵保持在肩膀正上方，如果做不到就換輕一點的重量。
en: Rolling the shoulders in circles: the movement is only straight up and straight down, so picture your shoulders sliding along a vertical line.
Bending the elbows and pulling with the arms: let your arms hang like two ropes holding the weight and let only the shoulders do the work.
Poking the chin forward and straining the neck: tuck your chin slightly and keep your ears over your shoulders, and use a lighter weight if you cannot hold that position.

zh: 伏地挺身加強版：雙手撐在肩膀正下方，身體從頭到腳跟成一直線；覺得太難可以改成膝蓋著地，或站著雙手撐牆。
手肘保持伸直，讓胸口在兩肩之間微微下沉，兩片肩胛骨會自然靠近。
吐氣，用手掌把地板（或牆面）推開，讓上背微微拱起、肩胛骨沿著肋骨往兩側滑開，在最遠處停一下。
吸氣，慢慢回到起始位置。
靠牆滑動：面對牆站立，前臂貼牆與肩同寬，輕輕把牆推開，吐氣讓前臂沿著牆往上滑，再吸氣慢慢滑回來。
en: Push-up plus: place your hands under your shoulders with your body in a straight line from head to heels; to make it easier, do it on your knees or standing with your hands on a wall.
Keep your elbows straight and let your chest sink slightly between your shoulders so the shoulder blades come together.
Breathe out and push the floor (or wall) away so your upper back rounds up a little and the shoulder blades slide apart around your ribs; pause at the end.
Breathe in and return slowly to the starting position.
Wall slide: stand facing a wall with your forearms on it shoulder-width apart, press gently into the wall, breathe out as you slide your forearms up, then breathe in and slide slowly back down.

zh: 彎手肘做成一般伏地挺身：手肘全程伸直，只讓肩胛骨前後移動，動作幅度本來就很小。
聳肩、脖子縮起來：讓肩膀遠離耳朵、脖子拉長，如果還是會聳肩就改成跪姿或撐牆的版本。
腰往下塌或屁股翹高：輕輕收緊腹部和臀部，讓頭、背、臀維持在同一直線上。
en: Bending the elbows so it becomes a regular push-up: keep the elbows straight the whole time and let only the shoulder blades move, since the range is meant to be small.
Shrugging and bunching up the neck: keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long, and switch to the kneeling or wall version if you still shrug.
Letting the lower back sag or the hips stick up: lightly tighten your stomach and buttocks so your head, back and hips stay in one line.

zh: 趴在墊子或床上，額頭墊一條小毛巾，雙手往頭頂斜前方伸直擺成 Y 字，大拇指朝上。
先把肩胛骨輕輕往後、往下收（想像往褲子後口袋的方向），肩膀遠離耳朵。
吐氣，把兩隻手臂抬離地面幾公分，停一到兩秒，脖子保持放鬆拉長。
吸氣，慢慢把手臂放回地面，完全放鬆後再做下一下。
en: Lie face down on a mat or bed with your forehead on a small towel and your arms reaching overhead and slightly out to form a Y, thumbs pointing up.
First draw your shoulder blades gently back and down (think of sliding them toward your back pockets) so your shoulders move away from your ears.
Breathe out and lift both arms a few centimetres off the floor, hold for one to two seconds, and keep your neck long and relaxed.
Breathe in and lower your arms slowly to the floor, relaxing completely before the next one.

zh: 抬手時聳肩：先把肩膀往下帶再抬手，如果還是會聳肩，就把抬的高度降低或先不拿重量。
用腰把胸口抬起來：額頭留在毛巾上、腹部輕輕收緊，只讓手臂和肩胛骨動。
抬太高或用甩的：這個動作幅度很小，慢慢抬、慢慢放，比抬得高更重要。
en: Shrugging as the arms lift: set your shoulders down first and then lift, and if you still shrug, lift lower or use no weight.
Arching the lower back to raise the chest: keep your forehead on the towel and your stomach lightly tight so only the arms and shoulder blades move.
Lifting too high or swinging: the range is small, and lifting and lowering slowly matters more than lifting high.

zh: 站直或坐直，雙手各握一個啞鈴垂在身體兩側，掌心朝前，手肘貼近身體。
吐氣，彎曲手肘把啞鈴往肩膀方向舉起，上臂保持不動。
在最高點停一下，手腕保持平直不要往內捲。
吸氣，慢慢把啞鈴放下，直到手臂接近伸直。
en: Stand or sit tall with a dumbbell in each hand hanging at your sides, palms facing forward and elbows close to your body.
Breathe out and bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause briefly at the top with your wrists straight, not curled inward.
Breathe in and lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are almost straight.

zh: 身體前後晃、用甩的把重量帶上來：換輕一點的重量，或背靠牆站著做，讓身體保持不動。
手肘往前跑或往外張開：把手肘固定在身體兩側，想像腋下夾著一張紙。
放下時太快、直接掉下來：放下的速度要比舉起時慢，全程都由自己控制重量。
en: Rocking the body and swinging the weight up: use a lighter weight, or stand with your back against a wall so your body stays still.
Letting the elbows drift forward or flare out: keep your elbows fixed at your sides, as if holding a sheet of paper under each armpit.
Dropping the weight on the way down: lower more slowly than you lift so you control the weight the whole way.

zh: 三頭下壓：面對滑輪機（或固定在高處的彈力帶）站好，雙手握住把手，手肘彎曲並夾在身體兩側，身體微微前傾、腹部收緊。
吐氣，把手往下壓到手肘伸直、雙手接近大腿，上臂保持不動。
吸氣，慢慢讓手回到胸口高度，手肘仍然貼在身體旁邊。
過頭伸展：雙手握住一個啞鈴舉到頭頂，手肘朝前上方；吸氣彎手肘讓啞鈴降到頭後方，再吐氣把手肘伸直。
en: Pushdown: stand facing a cable machine (or a band anchored up high), hold the handle with both hands, elbows bent and tucked at your sides, leaning forward slightly with your stomach tight.
Breathe out and press your hands down until your elbows are straight and your hands are near your thighs, keeping your upper arms still.
Breathe in and let your hands rise slowly to chest height with your elbows still at your sides.

Overhead extension: hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head with your elbows pointing forward and up; breathe in as you bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then breathe out and straighten your elbows.

zh: 手肘離開身體、跟著前後擺動：把手肘固定在身體兩側（過頭伸展時則靠近頭部），只讓前臂移動。
用身體的重量往下壓、肩膀往前拱：換輕一點的阻力，上半身保持穩定，肩膀放鬆下沉。
做過頭伸展時腰往前挺：收緊腹部、肋骨不要外翻，或改成坐在有靠背的椅子上做。
en: Letting the elbows leave your sides and swing back and forth: keep the elbows fixed at your sides (or close to your head for the overhead version) so only the forearms move.
Leaning your body weight into it and hunching the shoulders forward: use lighter resistance, keep your upper body steady and let your shoulders stay down and relaxed.
Arching the lower back during the overhead version: tighten your stomach and keep your ribs from flaring, or sit on a chair with a backrest.

zh: 坐著，把前臂放在大腿或桌面上，掌心朝上，手腕和手掌剛好超出邊緣，手握一個輕的啞鈴或水瓶。
吸氣，讓手腕慢慢往下彎，啞鈴朝地板方向降低。
吐氣，把手腕往上捲、把啞鈴抬高，前臂貼在大腿或桌面上不要離開。
在最高點停一下，再慢慢放回去。
en: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a table, palm up, with your wrist and hand just past the edge, holding a light dumbbell or water bottle.
Breathe in and let your wrist bend down slowly so the weight lowers toward the floor.
Breathe out and curl your wrist up to lift the weight, keeping your forearm resting on your thigh or the table.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 前臂跟著抬起來、用手肘出力：用另一隻手輕輕壓住前臂，只讓手腕動。
動作太快、用甩的：放慢速度，尤其是放下的時候要自己控制。
重量太重，只能動一點點：換輕一點的重量，在不會不舒服的範圍內把動作做完整。
en: Lifting the forearm and using the elbow: hold the forearm down gently with your other hand so only the wrist moves.
Moving too fast or jerking the weight: slow down, and control the lowering part in particular.
Using a weight so heavy that you barely move: choose a lighter weight and go through the full range that feels comfortable.

zh: 坐著，把前臂放在大腿或桌面上，掌心朝下，手腕和手掌剛好超出邊緣，手握一個輕的啞鈴或水瓶。
吸氣，讓手腕慢慢往下彎，手背朝前、啞鈴朝地板方向降低。
吐氣，把手背往上抬（手腕往上翹），前臂貼在大腿或桌面上不要離開。
在最高點停一下，再慢慢放回去。
en: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a table, palm down, with your wrist and hand just past the edge, holding a light dumbbell or water bottle.
Breathe in and let your wrist bend down slowly so the back of your hand faces forward and the weight lowers toward the floor.
Breathe out and lift the back of your hand up (bend the wrist upward), keeping your forearm resting on your thigh or the table.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 前臂離開支撐、整隻手一起抬：用另一隻手固定前臂，只讓手腕動。
握得太用力、肩膀跟著聳起來：握穩就好不必捏緊，肩膀和手肘保持放鬆。
放下時讓重量直接掉下去：這個動作的力氣通常比較小，請用很輕的重量，並慢慢數到三再放到底。
en: Letting the forearm leave its support so the whole arm lifts: hold the forearm in place with your other hand so only the wrist moves.
Gripping too hard and letting the shoulder hike up: hold the weight securely without squeezing, and keep your shoulder and elbow relaxed.
Letting the weight drop on the way down: these muscles are usually weaker, so use a very light weight and count slowly to three as you lower.

zh: 坐著或站著，手心握一顆軟球、捲起來的毛巾或握力器，手腕保持平直，手肘放鬆靠在身體旁邊。
五根手指（包含大拇指）一起慢慢用力握緊，用到「有出力但不會痛」的程度。
握住停幾秒，保持正常呼吸。
慢慢放鬆，把手指完全張開後再握下一次。
en: Sit or stand holding a soft ball, a rolled towel or a hand gripper in your palm, with your wrist straight and your elbow relaxed at your side.
Squeeze slowly with all five fingers, thumb included, to a level that feels like firm effort but not pain.
Hold for a few seconds while breathing normally.
Release slowly and open your fingers fully before the next squeeze.

zh: 握的時候憋氣、肩膀和脖子跟著用力：保持自然呼吸，肩膀放鬆下沉，只讓手和前臂出力。
手腕往內彎或往下垂：讓手腕和前臂維持一直線，必要時把前臂放在桌上支撐。
快速連續捏放或硬握到會痛：放慢速度，每一下都握穩再慢慢放開，力道以不痛為原則。
en: Holding your breath and tensing the shoulder and neck: breathe naturally, let your shoulder drop and relax, and let only the hand and forearm work.
Letting the wrist bend inward or droop: keep your wrist in line with your forearm, resting the forearm on a table if needed.
Pumping quickly or squeezing hard enough to hurt: slow down, hold each squeeze steadily and release slowly, staying below the point of pain.

zh: 坐著，手肘彎成 90 度貼在身體旁邊，或把前臂放在桌上、手掌超出桌緣；握住錘子的握柄，錘頭朝上，大拇指朝上，像握手的姿勢。
慢慢轉動前臂讓掌心朝上（旋後），錘頭會往外側倒，全程自己控制速度。
回到大拇指朝上的中間位置，再慢慢轉動前臂讓掌心朝下（旋前）。
回到中間位置，保持正常呼吸；握得離錘頭近一點會比較輕鬆，握得遠一點會比較費力。
en: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side, or rest your forearm on a table with your hand past the edge; hold a hammer by the handle with the head pointing up and your thumb up, like a handshake.
Slowly rotate your forearm so your palm turns up (supination), letting the hammer head tip outward under your control.
Return to the thumb-up middle position, then slowly rotate your forearm so your palm turns down (pronation).
Come back to the middle and keep breathing normally; holding closer to the hammer head makes it easier, and holding farther away makes it harder.

zh: 手肘離開身體、用肩膀幫忙轉：手肘固定在身體旁邊，可以在手肘和身體之間夾一條毛巾提醒自己。
讓錘子自己倒下去：錘頭倒向兩側時要慢慢放，如果控制不住，就把手握得離錘頭近一點。
手腕彎曲或歪向一邊：手腕和前臂保持一直線，轉動來自前臂而不是手腕。
en: Letting the elbow leave your side and turning from the shoulder: keep the elbow fixed at your side, and tuck a towel between elbow and body as a reminder.
Letting the hammer fall over by itself: lower the head slowly to each side, and hold closer to the head if you cannot control it.
Bending the wrist or tilting it to one side: keep your wrist in line with your forearm so the turning comes from the forearm, not the wrist.

zh: 把五根手指的指尖併攏，將一條橡皮筋套在五根手指（包含大拇指）外側，位置大約在指甲和第一個指節之間。
手腕保持平直，前臂可以放在桌上支撐。
慢慢把五根手指同時往外張開，對抗橡皮筋的拉力，張到覺得舒服的最大範圍。
停一下，再慢慢讓手指合起來；全程保持正常呼吸。
en: Bring the tips of all five fingers together and loop a rubber band around the outside of them, thumb included, roughly between the nails and the first finger joints.
Keep your wrist straight; you can rest your forearm on a table for support.
Slowly spread all five fingers apart at the same time against the pull of the band, as wide as feels comfortable.
Pause briefly, then let your fingers close slowly; breathe normally throughout.

zh: 橡皮筋太緊，手指幾乎張不開：換一條比較鬆或比較細的橡皮筋，先求動作完整再增加阻力。
張開後讓橡皮筋把手指彈回去：合起來的時候也要自己慢慢控制速度。
只有幾根手指在動，或手腕跟著彎：讓五根手指平均往外張，手腕保持不動。
en: Using a band so tight that the fingers barely open: switch to a looser or thinner band and get the full movement before adding resistance.
Letting the band snap the fingers back together: control the closing part slowly as well.
Moving only a few fingers or bending the wrist along with them: open all five fingers evenly and keep the wrist still.

zh: 坐在椅子上，脫掉鞋襪，把一條毛巾攤平放在光滑的地板上，腳踩在毛巾靠近自己的這一端，腳跟踩在地上。
腳跟不要離地，彎曲腳趾抓住毛巾，把毛巾往自己的方向拉。
放鬆並張開腳趾往前伸，再抓下一段，重複到整條毛巾都被拉到腳下。
把毛巾重新攤平，換另一隻腳；全程保持正常呼吸。
en: Sit on a chair with bare feet, lay a towel flat on a smooth floor, and place your foot on the near end with your heel on the floor.
Keeping your heel down, curl your toes to grip the towel and pull it toward you.
Relax and spread your toes, reach them forward, and grip the next section; repeat until the whole towel is bunched under your foot.
Flatten the towel again and switch feet; breathe normally throughout.

zh: 腳跟抬起來，或用整條腿把毛巾拖過來：腳跟固定踩在地上，只讓腳趾和腳掌前半部動。
腳趾用力過猛而抽筋：力道放輕、速度放慢，覺得快抽筋時先停下來，把腳趾張開伸展一下。
彎腰駝背、低頭盯著腳：坐直、膝蓋大約彎成 90 度，動作熟悉後就不需要一直看著腳。
en: Lifting the heel or dragging the towel with the whole leg: keep the heel planted and move only the toes and the front of the foot.
Clenching the toes so hard that the foot cramps: use less force and a slower pace, and if a cramp is coming, stop and spread your toes to stretch them.
Slouching and staring down at the foot: sit tall with your knees bent to about 90 degrees, and once you know the movement you do not need to keep watching your foot.

zh: 仰躺，膝蓋彎曲，雙腳與髖同寬踩在地上；雙手輕輕放在耳朵後方，或交叉放在胸前。
下巴微收，下巴和胸口之間保留大約一個拳頭的距離，腹部輕輕收緊。
吐氣，用腹部的力量把頭和肩膀捲離地面，捲到肩胛骨剛離地就好，下背留在地上。
停一下，吸氣，慢慢一節一節躺回去。
en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor hip-width apart; rest your hands lightly behind your ears or cross them on your chest.
Tuck your chin slightly, leaving about a fist of space between chin and chest, and gently tighten your stomach.
Breathe out and use your stomach muscles to curl your head and shoulders off the floor, just until the shoulder blades lift, with your lower back staying down.
Pause briefly, breathe in, and roll back down slowly.

zh: 用手把頭往前拉、脖子很痠：手只是輕輕托著頭，手肘打開，眼睛看斜上方的天花板。
整個上半身坐起來，或用甩的借力：這個動作幅度很小，慢慢捲起、慢慢放下，下背全程不離地。
用力時憋氣、腳跟著抬起來：捲起時吐氣、放下時吸氣，雙腳穩穩踩在地上。
en: Pulling the head forward with the hands and straining the neck: let your hands only support your head lightly, keep your elbows wide, and look up at the ceiling on a diagonal.
Sitting all the way up or using momentum: the range is small, so curl up slowly and lower slowly with your lower back on the floor the whole time.
Holding your breath and letting the feet lift: breathe out as you curl up and in as you lower, with both feet planted firmly.

zh: 趴在墊子上，手肘放在肩膀正下方，前臂貼地，雙腳往後伸直、腳尖踩地。
收緊腹部和臀部，把身體撐離地面，讓頭、背、臀部到腳跟成一直線。
眼睛看向雙手之間的地板，保持自然呼吸，不要憋氣。
姿勢開始走樣時，先把膝蓋放回地面休息。
死蟲式（較輕鬆的替代動作）：仰躺，雙手朝天花板伸直，髖部和膝蓋各彎 90 度；吐氣時慢慢放下對側的手和腳，下背保持貼近地面，吸氣回到起始位置後換邊。
en: Lie face down on a mat with your elbows directly under your shoulders, forearms on the floor, legs straight back and toes tucked under.
Tighten your belly and buttocks and lift your body off the floor so your head, back, hips and heels form one straight line.
Look at the floor between your hands and keep breathing normally; do not hold your breath.
When your form starts to slip, lower your knees to the floor and rest.

Dead bug (an easier alternative): lie on your back with arms pointing to the ceiling and hips and knees bent to 90 degrees; breathe out as you slowly lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping your lower back close to the floor, breathe in to return, then switch sides.

zh: 腰部往下塌：收緊腹部和臀部、骨盆微微後收；撐不住時改成膝蓋著地的版本。
臀部翹得太高：把臀部降到與肩膀、腳跟同一直線上。
憋氣或聳肩：保持平順呼吸，手肘用力推地，讓肩膀遠離耳朵。
en: Lower back sagging: tighten your belly and buttocks and tuck your pelvis slightly; if you cannot hold it, switch to the knees-down version.
Hips piked too high: lower your hips until they are in line with your shoulders and heels.
Holding your breath or shrugging: keep breathing smoothly and push your elbows into the floor so your shoulders stay away from your ears.

zh: 側躺，下方手肘放在肩膀正下方，前臂貼地，雙腿伸直、雙腳上下交疊（初學者可彎曲膝蓋，以膝蓋著地）。
收緊腹部和臀部，把骨盆抬離地面，讓頭、肩膀、髖部到腳踝成一直線。
上方的手放在腰上或朝天花板伸直，眼睛看向前方，保持自然呼吸。
慢慢把骨盆放回地面，換另一側重複。
en: Lie on your side with your bottom elbow directly under your shoulder, forearm on the floor, legs straight and feet stacked (beginners can bend the knees and rest on the bottom knee).
Tighten your belly and buttocks and lift your hips off the floor so your head, shoulders, hips and ankles form one straight line.
Rest your top hand on your waist or reach it toward the ceiling, look straight ahead and keep breathing normally.
Slowly lower your hips back to the floor, then repeat on the other side.

zh: 骨盆往下沉：把下方的腰側往天花板方向抬高；太吃力時改成膝蓋著地的版本。
身體往前倒或臀部往後翹：讓肩膀、髖部、腳踝疊在同一個平面上，想像背後貼著一面牆。
支撐側的肩膀塌陷、聳向耳朵：手肘用力推地，讓肩膀遠離耳朵。
en: Hips dropping: lift the bottom side of your waist toward the ceiling; if it is too hard, use the knees-down version.
Rolling forward or sticking the buttocks back: stack your shoulders, hips and ankles in one plane, as if your back were against a wall.
Sinking into the supporting shoulder so it shrugs toward your ear: push your elbow into the floor and keep the shoulder away from your ear.

zh: 坐在墊子上，膝蓋彎曲、腳跟踩地，雙手在胸前互握。
上半身微微往後傾，背部打直，腹部收緊。
吐氣時讓肩膀和胸口一起慢慢轉向一側，吸氣回到中間，再轉向另一側。
抗旋轉推（Pallof press）：側對固定好的彈力帶站立，雙手握住彈力帶放在胸前；吐氣時把雙手往正前方推直，不讓身體被拉轉，停一下再慢慢收回胸前，做完換邊。
en: Sit on a mat with your knees bent, heels on the floor and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Lean your upper body back slightly, keeping your back straight and your belly tight.
Breathe out as you slowly turn your shoulders and chest together to one side, breathe in as you return to the middle, then turn to the other side.

Pallof press (anti-rotation): stand side-on to a securely anchored resistance band, holding it with both hands at your chest; breathe out as you press your hands straight forward without letting your body be pulled round, pause, then slowly bring them back to your chest, and switch sides when done.

zh: 駝背、下背拱圓：挺起胸口、把脊椎拉長；做不到時就減少後傾的角度。
只有手臂左右擺動，軀幹沒有轉：放慢速度，讓肩膀和胸口帶著雙手一起轉。
做抗旋轉推時身體被彈力帶拉歪：雙腳與肩同寬站穩、收緊腹部和臀部，必要時站近一點以減少阻力。
en: Slouching or rounding the lower back: lift your chest and lengthen your spine; if you cannot, lean back less.
Only swinging the arms from side to side while the trunk stays still: slow down and let your shoulders and chest turn together with your hands.

Being pulled out of position by the band during the Pallof press: stand firmly with feet shoulder-width apart, tighten your belly and buttocks, and step closer to the anchor to reduce the resistance if needed.

zh: 採四足跪姿，雙手在肩膀正下方，膝蓋在髖部正下方，背部保持自然平直。
輕輕收緊腹部，吐氣時慢慢把一隻手往前伸、對側的腳往後伸，直到與身體同高。
停留一下，保持骨盆水平、身體不搖晃。
吸氣時慢慢收回起始位置，再換另一側。
en: Start on your hands and knees with hands directly under your shoulders, knees under your hips and your back naturally flat.
Gently tighten your belly and breathe out as you slowly reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until they are level with your body.
Pause briefly, keeping your hips level and your body steady.
Breathe in as you slowly return to the start, then switch sides.

zh: 腳抬得太高，讓腰部往下凹：腳只抬到與臀部同高，想像腳跟往後方的牆壁推。
骨盆往一側翻轉或身體搖晃：放慢速度，想像下背上放著一杯水不能灑出來；不穩時先只伸手或只伸腳。
抬頭或垂頭：眼睛看向雙手前方的地板，把後頸拉長。
en: Lifting the leg too high so the lower back arches: raise the leg only to hip height and imagine pushing your heel into the wall behind you.
Hips rolling to one side or the body wobbling: slow down and imagine a glass of water on your lower back that must not spill; if unsteady, start with only the arm or only the leg.
Lifting or dropping the head: look at the floor just in front of your hands and keep the back of your neck long.

zh: 趴在墊子上，雙腿伸直，雙手往前伸直（或放在身體兩側），額頭輕靠地面。
收緊臀部，吐氣時把胸口、雙手和雙腿同時稍微抬離地面。
眼睛看著地板、後頸拉長，在最高點停留一下。
吸氣時慢慢放回地面，放鬆後再做下一次。
en: Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight, arms reaching forward (or resting by your sides) and forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your buttocks and breathe out as you lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor at the same time.
Keep looking at the floor with the back of your neck long, and pause briefly at the top.
Breathe in as you slowly lower back to the floor, and relax before the next one.

zh: 抬得太高或用甩的方式抬起來：只要離地幾公分就好，慢慢抬、慢慢放。
抬頭往前看：下巴微收，視線保持看著地板。
憋氣：往上抬時吐氣，放下時吸氣。
en: Lifting too high or jerking up: a few centimetres off the floor is enough; lift slowly and lower slowly.
Craning the head up to look forward: tuck your chin slightly and keep your eyes on the floor.
Holding your breath: breathe out as you lift and breathe in as you lower.

zh: 仰躺、膝蓋彎曲（或舒服地坐著），一隻手放在胸口，另一隻手放在肚子上。
用鼻子慢慢吸氣，讓肚子像氣球一樣鼓起來，胸口的手盡量不動。
嘴唇微微噘起，慢慢吐氣，感覺肚子自然往內收。
讓吐氣比吸氣稍長一點，肩膀和脖子保持放鬆，用舒服的節奏重複。
en: Lie on your back with knees bent (or sit comfortably), one hand on your chest and the other on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise like a balloon while the hand on your chest stays as still as possible.
Purse your lips slightly and breathe out slowly, feeling your belly fall inward naturally.
Make the out-breath a little longer than the in-breath, keep your shoulders and neck relaxed, and repeat at a comfortable pace.

zh: 吸氣時聳肩、胸口起伏很大：放鬆肩膀，把注意力放在肚子上的手，讓那隻手先被推起來。
用力把肚子頂出去或吸得太猛：輕輕、慢慢地吸氣就好，覺得頭暈時先停下來恢復平常的呼吸。
吐氣太急：像把熱湯吹涼一樣，慢慢、均勻地吐氣。
en: Shrugging the shoulders or the chest heaving on the in-breath: relax your shoulders and focus on the hand on your belly, letting that hand rise first.
Forcing the belly out or breathing in too hard: breathe in gently and slowly, and if you feel light-headed, stop and return to normal breathing.
Breathing out too fast: breathe out slowly and evenly, as if cooling hot soup.

zh: 仰躺、膝蓋彎曲，或舒服地坐著，放鬆腹部、臀部和大腿。
想像同時憋住尿和忍住放屁，把骨盆底肌輕輕往內、往上收緊。
維持收緊幾秒，同時保持正常呼吸。
完全放鬆，休息的時間至少和收緊的時間一樣長，再做下一次。
en: Lie on your back with knees bent, or sit comfortably, and relax your belly, buttocks and thighs.
Imagine stopping the flow of urine and holding in gas at the same time, gently drawing the pelvic floor muscles inward and upward.
Hold the squeeze for a few seconds while breathing normally.
Relax completely, resting at least as long as you squeezed, before the next one.

zh: 夾緊臀部、大腿或用力縮肚子來代替：把手放在肚子和臀部上確認它們是放鬆的，力道放輕，只讓骨盆底出力。
憋氣或往下用力推：保持呼吸，可以在吐氣時收緊；感覺應該是往上提，而不是往下推。
收緊之後沒有完全放鬆：每一次都要感覺肌肉完全鬆開，再開始下一次。
en: Squeezing the buttocks, thighs or belly instead: rest your hands on your belly and buttocks to check they stay relaxed, ease off the effort and let only the pelvic floor work.
Holding your breath or bearing down: keep breathing, squeezing as you breathe out if it helps; the feeling should be a lift upward, not a push downward.
Not relaxing fully after the squeeze: feel the muscles let go completely each time before starting the next one.

zh: 坐直或站直，肩膀放鬆，眼睛平視前方。
把下巴水平往後收，像擠出雙下巴一樣，感覺後頸被拉長。
停留幾秒，保持自然呼吸，視線維持水平。
慢慢放鬆，回到起始位置。
en: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes looking straight ahead.
Draw your chin straight back horizontally, as if making a double chin, and feel the back of your neck lengthen.
Hold for a few seconds, breathing normally and keeping your gaze level.
Slowly relax back to the starting position.

zh: 變成低頭或抬頭：臉保持朝向正前方，讓下巴像抽屜一樣水平往後滑，可以用手指輕抵下巴當引導。
聳肩或整個身體往後仰：肩膀放鬆下沉，只有頭往後移動；可以背靠著牆練習。
太用力、脖子前側繃得很緊：輕輕出力就好，讓脖子前側表面的肌肉保持放鬆。
en: Nodding the head down or tipping it up: keep your face pointing straight ahead and slide your chin back like a drawer; a fingertip on the chin can guide the movement.
Shrugging or leaning the whole body back: let your shoulders relax down and move only your head; practising with your back against a wall can help.
Pushing too hard so the front of the neck tenses up: use gentle effort and keep the surface muscles at the front of your neck relaxed.

zh: 坐直，眼睛平視前方，下巴微收，雙手交握放在後腦勺。
頭輕輕往後推向雙手，雙手同時出力擋住，讓頭保持不動。
維持幾秒，保持自然呼吸。
慢慢放掉力量，休息一下再重複。
en: Sit tall with your eyes looking straight ahead and chin slightly tucked, and clasp both hands behind your head.
Gently push your head back into your hands while your hands resist, so your head does not move.
Hold for a few seconds, breathing normally.
Slowly release the pressure, rest briefly, then repeat.

zh: 頭真的往後仰、下巴抬起來：讓頭維持在中立位置，手擋的力量剛好等於頭推的力量。
一下子用力過猛：從很輕的力量開始慢慢增加到輕至中等的力道，放鬆時也要慢慢放。
憋氣或聳肩：保持平順呼吸，肩膀放鬆下沉。
en: Letting the head actually tip back and the chin lift: keep your head in neutral, with your hands resisting exactly as hard as your head pushes.
Pushing hard all at once: start very lightly and build gradually to light-to-moderate effort, and release just as slowly.
Holding your breath or shrugging: keep breathing smoothly and let your shoulders relax down.

zh: 坐直，眼睛平視前方，把右手手掌貼在頭的右側、耳朵上方。
頭輕輕往右側（耳朵靠向肩膀的方向）推向手掌，手同時出力擋住，讓頭保持不動。
維持幾秒，保持自然呼吸。
慢慢放鬆，換左側重複。
en: Sit tall with your eyes looking straight ahead and place your right palm on the right side of your head, just above the ear.
Gently push your head sideways to the right (ear toward shoulder) into your palm while your hand resists, so your head does not move.
Hold for a few seconds, breathing normally.
Slowly relax, then repeat on the left side.

zh: 頭跟著轉動或往前傾：鼻子始終朝向正前方，頭維持在中立位置。
聳肩或身體歪向一邊：兩邊肩膀放鬆、保持同高，上半身坐直。
力量太大或突然用力：慢慢加到輕至中等的力道，放鬆時也要慢慢放。
en: Letting the head turn or drift forward: keep your nose pointing straight ahead and your head in neutral.
Shrugging or leaning the body to one side: keep both shoulders relaxed and level, and sit upright.
Using too much force or pushing suddenly: build up slowly to light-to-moderate effort and release just as slowly.
